id: \bTo the west is the sea, to the east is a cliff. What a place to live.
en: \bTo the west is the sea, to the east is a cliff. What a place to live.
it: \bA ovest c'è il mare, a est una scogliera. Che posto in cui vivere.

id: \bMy brother and I traveled for a long time to find a home like this.
en: \bMy brother and I traveled for a long time to find a home like this.
it: \bIo e mio fratello abbiamo viaggiato a lungo per trovare una casa come questa.

id: \rWould you like me to groom one of your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like me to groom one of your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi che faccia la toelettatura a uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rWhich Pokémon do you want me to groom?
en: \rWhich Pokémon do you want me to groom?
it: \rA quale Pokémon vuoi che faccia la toelettatura?

id: \rThere! \v[2] looks a lot happier and prettier now!
en: \rThere!  \v[2] looks a lot happier and prettier now!
it: \rEcco!  \v[2] ora sembra molto più felice e più bello!

id: \bI would never let my grandkids stay here. They should grow up in a city where the culture is stronger.
en: \bI would never let my grandkids stay here. They should grow up in a city where the culture is stronger.
it: \bNon lascerei mai stare qui i miei nipoti. Dovrebbero crescere in una città con una cultura più ricca.

id: \bWe've discovered loads of fossils and have more than enough to give away. Want to have your very own Amaura?
en: \bWe've discovered loads of fossils and have more than enough to give away. Want to have your very own Amaura?
it: \bAbbiamo scoperto un sacco di fossili e ne abbiamo più che a sufficienza da regalare. Vuoi un Amaura tutto tuo?

id: \bOh, you don't have any space for it.
en: \bOh, you don't have any space for it.

id: \bThat's fine. Come back if you ever do.
en: \bThat's fine. Come back if you ever do.

id: \bWe've discovered loads of fossils and have more than enough to give away. Want to have your very own Tyrunt?
en: \bWe've discovered loads of fossils and have more than enough to give away. Want to have your very own Tyrunt?
it: \bAbbiamo scoperto un sacco di fossili e ne abbiamo più che a sufficienza da regalare. Vuoi un Tyrunt tutto tuo?

id: \bMy wife left me. Use this to keep two lovers together.
en: \bMy wife left me. Use this to keep two lovers together.
it: \bMia moglie mi ha lasciato. Usa questo per tenere uniti due innamorati.
